acip: KHA CIG NA RE, BUM PA CHOS CAN, KHYOD YANG YIN, BUM PA YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA YOD PAR THAL, KHYOD BUM PA DANG MI 'GAL BA YIN PA'I PHYIR ZER NA

english: Suppose someone comes along and makes this final claim: Let's consider a coffee cup. There must exist an example of something which is both it and something which is a coffee cup, Because it is no contradiction for something to be a coffee cup and a coffee cup.
